ocr.description: These currency mappings are retained for administration and are not used in current automatic receipt analysis. Vision detects the language from the image, and OCR fallback uses the AI server's default language settings. The account book currency does not determine the receipt language.

keyword.title: Keyword settings

form.title: System settings
form.description: Limits and default behavior for all GROUP/OPEN rooms.
form.notice: Room settings set by an OWNER/ADMIN cannot exceed these system limits. Changes apply to subsequent AI actions and validation.

messages.loadFailed: Could not load chat AI settings.
messages.saved: Chat AI settings have been saved.
messages.saveFailed: Could not save chat AI settings.
messages.forbidden: Only administrators can access chat AI settings.
messages.invalidValues: Check the setting ranges, minimum and maximum AI response delays, and the allowed REVIVAL time window.

members.label: Maximum AI members per room
members.help: Default: 2. The maximum AI members that can be added to a GROUP/OPEN room.

conversationRate.label: CONVERSATION response rate (%)
conversationRate.help: Default: 15%. The proportion of ordinary conversations considered for AI responses without an explicit mention.

conversationCooldown.label: CONVERSATION cooldown (seconds)
conversationCooldown.help: Default: 180 seconds. Limits repeated AI interventions immediately after an AI message.

minHumanMessages.label: Minimum human messages after an AI reply
minHumanMessages.help: Default: 2. AI will not intervene autonomously until this many human messages have been sent.

responseDelayEnabled.label: Use natural AI response delays
responseDelayEnabled.help: Deliver MENTION/CONVERSATION replies after a short random delay. No additional delay applies to REVIVAL.

responseDelayMin.label: Minimum AI response delay (ms)
responseDelayMin.help: Default: 1,200 ms. The minimum wait between completing an AI reply and saving and sending it.

responseDelayMax.label: Maximum AI response delay (ms)
responseDelayMax.help: Default: 3,500 ms. The upper limit for a random delay that partly reflects reply length.

revivalFirst.label: REVIVAL 1st wait (hours)
revivalFirst.help: Default: 24 hours. The earliest first proactive reply after the last human message.

revivalSecond.label: REVIVAL 2nd wait (hours)
revivalSecond.help: Default: 72 hours. The additional wait after the first REVIVAL receives no response.

revivalThird.label: REVIVAL 3rd wait (hours)
revivalThird.help: Default: 168 hours (7 days). Automatic REVIVAL stops if there is still no response.

contextMessages.label: Maximum context messages
contextMessages.help: Default: 30. The maximum recent messages sent to the AI server.

contextCharacters.label: Maximum context characters
contextCharacters.help: Default: 12,000 characters. Older context is removed first when this limit is exceeded.

replyCharacters.label: Maximum AI reply characters
replyCharacters.help: Default: 800 characters. Keeps replies short and conversational.

mentionCount.label: MENTION request limit
mentionCount.help: Rate limit per user and room. Default: 5 requests.

mentionWindow.label: MENTION rate limit window (seconds)
mentionWindow.help: Default: 60 seconds. The time window used to count requests.

revivalStart.label: REVIVAL window start
revivalStart.help: Default: 10:00 in the system time zone.

revivalEnd.label: REVIVAL window end
revivalEnd.help: Default: 22:00. Proactive replies are spread across the allowed time window.
